name: render_ledger
claim: Render-on-observation saves compute only when the observer set is restricted (A1): with any-interaction observers the saving is below 1% for every consistency policy; with humans-only observation at p=0.1 the keep-record policy covers at least 99% of cells within 200 steps; and only true deletion produces contradictions on repeat observation (delete rate > 0, keep-record and recompute rate = 0, humans-only).
refute_if: any_interaction saving >= 0.01 for any policy, OR keep-record coverage < 0.99 at p_observe=0.1 humans_only, OR delete contradiction rate == 0 humans_only, OR keep-record/recompute contradiction rate > 0 - any of these at >=3 of 5 seeds
